Complete [[Ring of Fire]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Clear the way on the [[Ring of Fire Island Chain|Ring of Fire islands]].
* *BONUS* Return the [[Spectral Essence]] from the [[Eidolon]] to the [[Ancient Seer]].
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 5,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,000 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 30 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 45 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
As per the [[Ring of Fire#Walkthrough|Ring of Fire]] mission.

==Dialogues==
===Initial dialogue===
;Zaishen Mission
:''"It is written in the [[Flameseeker Prophecies]]: your destiny is in the Ring of Fire."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
|ask = The battle rages on! All able-bodied heroes should hasten to defend those bravely protecting [[Tyria (world)|Tyria]]. }}

===Reward dialogue===
;Zehnchu
:''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

==Notes==
{{bug|Contrary to the quest objective text and the mission bonus, killing the Eidolon is counted as completion, rather than returning the Spectral Essence.}}
